column3: The Argent Crusade and the Knights of the Ebon Blade have assaulted the gates of the Icecrown Citadel and are preparing for a massive attack upon the Scourge. Our mission is a bit more subtle but equally as important.
With the attention of the Lich King turned towards the front gate, we'll be working our way through the side in search of information that will enable us to defeat him once and for all.
Our scouts have reported that the Lich King has a private chamber outside of the frozen throne, deep within a place called the Halls of Reflection. That is our target champions.
We will cut a swath of destruction through this cursed place, and find a way to enter the Halls of Reflection. If there is anything of value to be found here, it will be found in the Halls.
Your first mission is to destroy the machines of death within this wretched engine of souls and clear a path for our soldiers.
The Dark Lady watches over you. Make haste.

Excellent work, champions. We shall set up our base camp in these chambers. My Magi will get the Scourge transport device working shortly. Step inside when you are ready for your next mission. I will meet you on the other side.
He's too powerful! Heroes, quickly! Come to me! We must leave this place immediately! I will do what I can to hold him in place while we flee!
I don't believe it. Frostmourne stands before us, unguarded, just as the gnome claimed. Come, heroes!
He's too powerful. Heroes, quickly. Come to me. We must leave this place at once. I will do what I can to hold him in place while we flee.
Standing this close to the blade that ended my life, and the pain, it is renewed.
I dare not touch it. Stand back, stand back, as I attempt to commune with the blade. Perhaps our salvation lies within.
Uther! Uther the Lightbringer! Ow!
The Lich King is here. Then my destiny shall be fulfilled on this day.
There must be a way!
Who could bear such a burden?
The frozen throne.
You will not escape me that easily, Arthas. I will have my vengeance.
There's an opening up ahead. Go now!
We're almost there. Don't give up.
A blasted, dead end. So this is how it ends. Prepare yourselves, heroes, for today we make our final stand.
We are safe for now. His strength has increased tenfold since our last battle. It will take a mighty army to destroy the Lich King. An army greater than even the Horde can rouse.
Champions to my aid keep the Lich King scourge from interfering and I shall break down this barrier
No wall can hold the banshee queen. Keep the undead at bay, heroes. I will tear this barrier down.
Another barrier? Sten strong, champions! I will bring the wall down!
I grow tired of these games, office. Your walls can't stop me.
You won't impede our escape fiend. Keep the undead off me while I bring this barrier down.
So, it is done.
I had not dared to trust my senses too many times as the Lich King made me to be a fool.
Finally, he has been made to pay for the atrocities he imposed upon my people.
May Azeroth never fail to remember the horrible price we paid for our weakness, for our pride.
But what now, hero? What of those freed from his grasp but still shackled to their mortal coils?
Leave me.
I have much to ponder.
AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA
Why should the Benji Queen spare your miserable life?
Frostmourne? The Leech King is never without his blade, if you are lying to me.
A fitting end for a traitor. Come, we must free the slaves and see what is within the Lich King's chamber for ourselves.
Soldiers of the Horde, attack!
Pathetic weaklings.
You will have to battle your way through this cesspit on your own.
Free any Horde slaves that you come across. We will most certainly need their assistance in battling Taranis. I will gather reinforcements and join you on the other side of the quarry.
Take cover, behind me, quickly!
I thought he'd never shut up. At last, Syndragosa silenced that long-winded fool. To the halls of Reflection Champions, our objective is near. I can sense it.
Let none survive.
May my aim be true.
We are the Forsaken. We will slaughter anyone who stands in our way.
What are we if not slaves to this torment?
What joy is there in this curse?
I have no time for games.
Greetings, my most loyal ally. I speak to you now from beyond the veil of death.
Here, in this place of eternal darkness, my work, my penance, continues.
Though the maw is an unlikely place for one to find peace, each soul I rescue helps mine feel a little more... whole.
As I ponder my deeds since being raised into undeath, I have many regrets, things said and choices made that I wish could be taken back.
But there is one thing for which I will always be proud, helping the Forsaken find their place in a world that shunned them.
My time to lead may be over, but I will always stand with you against those who would cast you out and call you monsters.
Under the leadership of the Desolate Council, a new group of voices has arisen to represent all forsaken.
Stand proud in the horde, and know that all of you were so much more than arrows in my quiver.
As much as the family I was born into, you will always be my people. And one day, I do hope to walk among you once again.
I must go. There are many more souls yet to be freed, among them one that is most dear to me.
Shurello Rama, my friend.
I will not fall. Not here, not now.
I feel better already.
Huh, a bold move.
She's attacking the towers again!
And there goes the other one.
You do realize we are directly below it, right?
I had kind of hoped you had perished.
Ha, if he's not dead.
I can't wait to see the look on his face when I animate his corpse. We better win this battle!
I can raise your dead, Regent Lord. Your Rangers can fight again.
I'm sorry to see your lack of commitment. Hmm... what of the human corpses?
Rise, my angels! Let your screams fill the streets of Orgrimmar with terror!
I see the dragon maw have thrown in their lot with Garrosh.
My arrows alone cannot bring that monstrosity down.
Oh, bring her down quick, so I can wrap my fingers around her neck.
Garrosh really has gone all out this time, hasn't he? I expected more spikes, honestly.
A hail of death approaches, bring them to their fate.
Champion, come forward!
Turn and face your peers, champion, so that they may bear witness to your ruthlessness and cunning.
Before you stands the Horde's greatest champion, hero of countless victories against our unrelenting foe.
The ancient weapon they wield inspires fear in the hearts of those who would threaten our way of life.
So join me, heroes, in honoring our champion, Bane of the Alliance.
For the Horde!
Fast or raw, I have not seen it in years. That's a windrunner family heirloom you have slung across your back.
My mother passed it down to my eldest sister. May it bring you better fortune than it did her.
Remember, champion, that Thostora represents my family's legacy, my legacy. The deeds you perform while wielding it reflect upon me.
It is fitting that the bow be in the hands of so skilled a marksman. I trust you will remain worthy of it. Do not disappoint me.
A decisive victory, these alliance lapdogs scatter before the might of the Horde!
Grey mains forces hold this warden tower! Break their ranks! Show no mercy!

The Alliance will be upon us soon, and we have nowhere to run.
Do not question me, Nefanos. Now go. Make for the eternity and bring this hero with you.
Organize our defenses beginning with the rear. I want bat riders in the air and catapults at the ready.
What have we here? Another one of Greymane's mercenaries?
Ah, my loyal hero.
No matter, soon you will witness the birth of a new age.
You must not languish here. The Aegis cannot fall into enemy hands.
If you ever make it out of here, that is.
The future of the Horde depends on you and me. Find your way back to Stormheim. I will be waiting.
Are you familiar with the Vrykul? Towering, brutish warriors from an ancient stock. Subtlety is not a value they hold in high regard.
Their legends speak of the Aegis of Aggramar. To claim it, one must undergo some kind of trial. One must be... worthy.
The new catapults are faster and more powerful than ever before. I have our goblin allies to thank for that.
I trust you are more than capable of handling whatever trials stand between you and the ages.
Truthfully, Stormheim holds another treasure, one that I will be pursuing by my own means.
Nathanos has been training a new generation of rangers. They represent both our past and our future.
I think often about our future hero. My people cannot reproduce. Are we not destined then to wither away eventually?
No. The Forsaken will never stop fighting.
Not while I reign. Not when there are still beings out there with the power to stop death.
Good. Send a bat. Tell them we are leaving shortly.
Champion, as your new Warchief, I share with you the burden of securing our future.
To that end, my fleet is preparing to sail for the Broken Isles. When you set foot in Stormheim, you shall have the full power of the Forsaken at your back."
Together, we will ensure that no one can oppose the might of the Horde.
Gul'dan, you will pay for this!
The armies of Azeroth will triumph this day, together!
Monsters from the fail fire, hard forces be ready
Another wave incoming!
Let's go, Horde! It's time to show the Alliance how we slay demons!
All Horde forces on my target! We're going to bring down that demon!
Consider your job done then, Ryn.
All yours, Alliance!
No time to gloat, Ryn. We've got to stop Gul'dan before he summons another one of those things.
We'll take the ridge and cover your flank.
Good luck, Varian.
Take up positions. We hold them off. We have to.
Pull Vayne back to my position! Close ranks!
Let's Chatting Rin kill him already!
Vol'jin! Pull him back! Keep your lines steady! We have to hold!
Everyone, pull back to me! We make our stand here!
There are so many of them.
There's nothing we can do! The ridge is lost! Court forces, if you value your lives, cut a path through to the shore. We have to get out of here, or there won't be anyone left to fight.
knock your arrows hold fire
It's about time you showed up.
You heard him, Rangers! We cut those demons down! Fire a volley on my mark! Now!
Well, that was invigorating. Now how did they manage to get so many demons here so quickly?
And now we know how to destroy them. It's them or us! Let's get moving so we make sure it's not us.
This is Argent Crusade Insignia.
One shot, one kill.
Too easy.
That's half of the city down. This is going better than expected.
right to the face!
We'll never bow to you!
This was too easy. Something's wrong.
Anyone have any ideas how we're going to get across this thing?
Convenient.
Chieftain Bloodhoof, have our champion join you for your feast in Thunderbluff. By the time dessert is served, I want the oath of loyalty to the Horde.
What have you to say, chieftain?
I accept your oath of loyalty. The Horde offers its protection and expects your obedience.
For the Horde!
Do not return until Suramar's strength is pledged to the Horde.
Indeed, First Arcanist.
For millenia, Suramar stood alone. This day, you become part of something greater. I accept your oath of service, Alistra.
For the Horde!
Leaders of the Horde, I summoned you here, along with one of our greatest champions, because our enemies are gathering their strength.
The Alliance is scouring the far corners of Azeroth in search of every advantage against us. We must do the same.
War is coming. We need fresh blood added to the ranks of the Horde. What say you?
A simple people, but strong. They would be a boon on the battlefield.
Even without the Nightwell, Suramar holds vast arcane resources, a most useful arrow added to my quiver.
Each option would have its uses. I believe our champion knows these peoples. Which potential ally do you suggest we pursue first?
Ah, the young hero comes before me. I am told you show great promise. Let us hope these reports prove true.
The High Mountain Taran possess strength and courage. We will have need of such qualities in the days to come.
The Nightborne are a wise and powerful people. The ancient knowledge you possess will prove a great boon to our cause.
The Horde has many rivals in this world. Some call us enemies, others call us outcasts, but we find strength in unity and in defiance of those who would challenge our freedom.
Rest assured, I will be taking note of your progress. As War Chief, I expect much of you, and I reward those who serve me well.
Enough of these pleasantries. You have much to prove, hero. Wherever your path takes you, know that you fight for the Horde.
You have observed our operations in Syllathus Champion. Clearly the Alliance is doing everything in its power to undermine our efforts.
The Horde's selfless leadership in the war against the Legion has left our ranks depleted. Our enemies slather at the thought of stealing what is ours. We will not let them.
I have authorized the building of an embassy in Olgromah. From it we will win others to our cause. Meet me there at once.
Go. I have much to do.
Serve the horde, serve me.
We will bring the Alliance to its knees.
I will grow the ranks of the Forsaken, one way or another.
All will serve the Horde in time.
We will claim what is ours.
The lifeblood of Azeroth belongs to the Horde.
State your business to your Warchief.
I trust you will not waste my time.
Come forward.
Greetings, champion.
Our true work is just beginning.
There will be a new future for the Horde.
Serve me well, and you will be rewarded.
No doubt I am your favorite win-runner sister, right? Right?
I have taken note of your progress. It seems I may have to send you to Nathanos for remedial training.
Did you think I would not notice the way you leer at my dark rangers? I suggest you keep your eyes and thoughts to yourself.
Plans? Little old me? What sort of plans could I possibly have?
What say you, champion? Are you prepared to pursue a new ally?
The Magha Orcs are legendary for their battle prowess. I will have need of such fearless soldiers in the days ahead.
I see the value in this plan, but I thought the door to that other Drano had closed.
Our Nightborne allies possess a particular affinity for teleportation. I suggest you draw upon their knowledge to aid you on your journey.
Etrig has told me of your people's strength. I trust honor means as much to you as it does to him.
I accept your loyalty overlord. Your people are welcome within the gates of Orgrimmar.
For the Horde!
These wisps are little more than insects to be crushed. Snuff out each light, one by one, and soon the sky will fill with darkness.
That's exactly the kind of message I want to send to Malfurion. Excellent work.
But victory demands more than boosting our own strength. It requires hobbling our enemies until they grovel before us.
Use the footholds you secured in Kulturas to cripple the boy-king's forces. Shake their faith in their futile cause.
Take their hope and you will claim victory for the Horde!
Our goblin allies continue to prove their worth. They have pinpointed deposits of Azerite on islands scattered throughout the vast seas.
We must seize the advantage, explore these islands and lay claim to them, before the Alliance does.
In war, there are times when a single well-placed blade in the back does more damage than a thousand swords on the battlefield.
Work with Garona Halforcen to assemble a unit of the Horde's most cunning and devious operatives. You will dispatch these forces on covert missions throughout Kul Tiras and Zandalor.
Use their stealth and guile to reveal weaknesses in the enemy's defenses and exploit them.
The world is full of soldiers, Champion, but few truly have the stomach for war. You, it seems, have a genuine taste for it.
Though victory still eludes us, it draws closer every day. We must not rest until the last flicker of hope in the boy-king's heart turns to ashes.
Azerite emerges amongst the ruins of Darkshore. We must not allow the Alliance to gather a single shard of it.
Cold Tiras has become a rallying point for the Alliance. The return of its vaunted navy has emboldened them. But soon those tide-borne Curs will pay the price for defying us.
You embody the best of the Horde, champion. I know that you will be the spark that sets Boralus ablaze.
For the Horde!
Nathanos, your conversion of Brother Zelling is already yielding results. He has revealed the location of the shipwreck we seek.
You must act quickly. Use the cover of night to conceal your search for the remains. Those waters are fraught with Alliance patrols.
To ensure your success, I am sending along an operative who possesses a unique set of skills. I believe they will prove quite useful on this mission.
Stromgarde was a seat of Alliance power at the heart of the Eastern Kingdoms, before the Keep fell to ruin.
Now the boy-king sends his underlings to reclaim it. We cannot allow them to succeed.
Our forces are assembled at Argorok. Rally your allies and take strong guard for the Horde!
You were the right arrow for the shot, champion.
Very nice, champion. I will have the Azerite added to our reserves.
Saurfang has crested the mountains between Darkshore and Felwood. Meet him at Shattersphere Vale and ensure that the passage he seeks is secure.
The Alliance seeks to use siege weaponry against us. How quaint. Show them what the Horde is capable of.
We struck a significant blow to the reserves, hero. Well done.
Azerite emerges amongst the ruins of Darkshore. We must not allow the Alliance to gather a single shard of it.
A very nice champion. I will have the Azerite added to our reserves.
Another victory.
I never doubted you for a moment.
These ruins are rich with natural resources. Ours for the taking. Do not allow the Kaldorei to stop us, champion.
Alliance saboteurs have infiltrated our foothold. Flush them out. Make them bleed.
Hmm, the wisps were dispersing. Excellent. Our plan shows promise.
Like Aldor, I draw power from pendants made of moonstone. Do whatever you must to deprive them of these trinkets.
Champion, we need to hold the Kaldorei's attention while I devise a solution to our wisp problem.
It seems the wisps are susceptible to distraction. We will exploit this weakness to get past them.
Sarfang, take a squad into Felwood, seek a path over the mountain into Darkshore, but leave the siege weapons under my command.
We will squeeze Malfurion from both sides.
Find one or make one time is a luxury we do not possess
Then it is decided. Safang, Nathanos, you will leave at once.
The scouting party I led to Malfurion underestimated the Wisps, and they paid the price for doing so.
We cannot destroy the Wisps, not in numbers enough to matter, but we may be able to disperse them.
Precisely what I was thinking. Champion, would you be so kind as to test out theory?
To Zoramgar, quickly!
I will order our Enchantress to infuse these moonstones with Azerite. Their power now serves the Horde.
sappers gather your gear and follow me bring every shredder we have
Azerite. With this in our grasp, all who dared to oppose the Horde will fall.
Proceed with caution, champion. It seems the Alliance has beaten us to it.
Make quick work of this place.
That ship must have come from Darnassus, which means...
I have a crow to hunt.
Hmm, I see this makes you uneasy. These ancients have been turned against you, Druid, against their sacred charge.
End their existence, or they will coat this forest in our people's blood.
Regret nothing. You did well.
My victory was inevitable. He was merely wasting my time.
The Kaldorei use moon wells to replenish their strength in battle. Draw from the wells what you will, then render them unusable. Am I understood?
Finish him and be done with it. Take a moment if you like. Then take his head. Meet me at the world tree.
Wild Bend River is locked in a stalemate, and Malfurion knows it.
We must stay the course for now.
I will continue leading our soldiers through the wall while we await word from Safang.
In the meantime, we will do all that we can to keep the Kaldorei under pressure.
We shall not afford them the luxury of a peaceful night's rest. This is war.
There will be nowhere to run when next we meet Malfurion.
You
Soldiers, no! Do not rush the...
Ugh, fools! At least now we know how dangerous the wisps can be.
The Moon Well Essence should serve you well in battle. Be sure to do the same to any wells the Kaldorei consecrate in the future.
Malfurion, how gracious of you to join us.
Who would have guessed that you would come to protect your precious trees?
No! My eyes! It burns!
Where did you fly away to, little bird?
Pass through the wall! Quickly! I cannot hold it much longer!
These elementals will serve as fuel for our demolishers. Kill them, as well as any Kaldorei who get in your way.
We advance as the fires continue to burn.
Look up and around you. The trees have eyes, champion. Blind them.
Sofang, it's about time.
Look around, you hero. What a lovely sight. The wisps are scattering. One by one, the wall comes crashing down.
Alliance saboteurs have infiltrated our foothold. Flush them out. Make them bleed.

Now is the time. The world tree is ours for the taking. Find Sarfang. We shall finish this once and for all."
When I sent you on this mission, I did not foresee this outcome.
Our attack was meant to end a war before it began, to capture an enemy's home and annihilate their leaders in one stroke, to inflict a wound that would bleed the Alliance dry.
We have only partially succeeded. The Alliance will retaliate. They will come for us. For me, for you.
But they are bleeding. Their anger will prove a weakness, not a strength, in the war to come.
Rest while you can. Prepare for the battles ahead. I will have need of you.
Champions of the Horde, your aid is required at Wildbend River. This is our chance for victory!

Our encampment is secure for now, but remain vigilant.
We pass through the wall on my command.
Brace yourselves!
You
Once a breach has been made, the pain is bearable. Just give me a moment.
My faith in you was well placed. The will of the Kaldorei will soon crumble.
The Kaldorei are deadliest in the dark. Jump into the fray and deal with them before night falls.
Though our long war against the Legion has ended, the Horde cannot afford a moment of respite.
An audience. Perfect. Stay still, Alliance Dog. Watch me strike down one of your greatest heroes.
Meet me in my chambers in the Undercity, where we can discuss our next move, discreetly.
Azerite powder kegs have been flung from our ships gather them quickly before they sink
Your efforts are needed elsewhere, champion. I have a team of goblins ready to scour for the rest.
My Dark Rangers require your help, champion. Lend aid to any that you find.
Even with all their training, those dark rangers seem to have miscalculated their attacks. Perhaps Blightcrawler should have words with them.
That cargo belongs to the Horde. Do not allow the Alliance to lay their hands upon it.
The weapons you reclaimed will prove useful to our war effort, skillfully done.
So the ancients decided to come out and play. Let us give them a rude awakening.
Imagine, to sleep for thousands of years, only to awaken to defeat, who pathetic.
That night elf commander is testing my patience. Break her!
Poor thing. She barely got a chance to swing.
Our army has Malfurion soldiers on their heels. We must push further into Darkshore while we hold the advantage.
My faith in you was well-placed. The will of the Kaldorei will soon crumble.
The Kaldorei are deadliest in the dark. Jump into the fray and deal with them before night falls.
We struck a significant blow to their reserves, hero. Well done.
Do not relent, hero. These savage elves would do you no such favor.
In times of war, you must kill or be killed. There is nothing else to say.
The Alliance scours Dark Shore, seeking to root out our footholds. We must not lose ground. Defend what is ours.
You fight with finesse, and further, such effort serves to inspire all my soldiers, champion.
It seems the Kaldorei have mastered reinforcements. This one may prove to be a challenge. I expect victory.
I never doubted you for a moment.
Saurfang has crested the mountains between Darkshore and Felwood. Meet him at Shatasphere Vale, and ensure that the passage he seeks is secure.
You are the right arrow for the shot, champion.
Another Kaldorei commander in the wrong place, at the wrong time. Dispatch her at once, we can't allow her to gather reinforcements.
Cut the rose before it can sprout thorns, I always say.
Orcs make fine soldiers, but each one eats as much as a dozen goblins. Our food stores need replenishment, mind slaughtering a few beasts while you strike down the Kaldorei?
That should quell their appetites. For a while, at least.
An elemental of pure Azerite. Slay it, champion, but do not destroy it. Gather as much of its resin as you can.
I have never seen so much Azerite in one place.
We have some windriders available to us. Gather our explosives and wreak havoc on that wisp wall. We will send a message to Malfurion.
They're not nearly as resilient as they appear, are they, champion? One by one, they fall.
The Alliance seeks to use siege weaponry against us? How quaint. Show them what the Horde's demolishers can do.
That was a lesson they won't soon forget.
Ever use an Azerite Bomb before? Want to witness true power? Brace yourself for Impact Champion. I think you will be pleasantly surprised.
All right, that's enough. Let's save some for the grand finale.
Forget the army, we can deal with them later! Blast the siege towers!
Do not question me, Saurfang. We must draw their attention from my war machine so it can destroy the towers. Casualties are inevitable.
Enough meddling! The towers! The towers!
Ah what have we here? Has the Lion of Stormwind finally come out to play? You have no idea what you're up against, boy king. We have only just begun!
Prepare the blight, let it rain down upon their armies.
This is no time for sentiment, High Overlord.
War demands that we take a more direct approach.
DESTROY THEM!
Bane! Pull them back!
Is the undercity evacuated?
Then it's time to finish this once and for all. Sarfang, rally your troops. I will prepare the Azerite machine.
Everyone, move! Cut them off with the reserves. Do not let them pass!
Saurfang, where did you go?
Meet with Lotharmar! Quickly! Do not fail me, Nathanos!
Slay them all, champions! Mark my words. King Anduin and his army did not come here for their amusement. They mean to destroy us. Show them no mercy! For they would show you none in return.
You
Everyone! Follow Nathanos to the courtyard! I will block the Alliance from behind!
KEEP MOVING!
We're almost there! Make haste, heroes!
So good of you to finally show up, High Overlord.
Honor means nothing to a corpse, Saurfang. You have the luxury of underestimating death, but it is something with which I am intimately familiar.
Maybe you don't care if your people die so long as it's honorable, but to me, this horde is worth saving. Anyone who disagrees does not deserve to stand among us.
So die your warrior's death, High Overlord Saurfang. It means little to me. Perhaps I will raise your broken body to serve me once more.
Or perhaps, you will have a chance to say hello to your son.
Champions, with me, you are invited to bear witness to the grand finale.
I have taken the liberty of assembling a team for you. Retrieve my prize.
Ah, there you are. I was beginning to wonder.
I require the services of one whom I can trust completely.
Certain members of the Horde seem to feel my recent actions have been indiscriminate.
But I understand discretion very well.
To win this war, the Horde needs allies.
The boy king has something that does not belong to him. I want it back.
You are to infiltrate Stormwind and liberate a political prisoner, one who could change the course of the war, in our favor.
Are you up to the task?
Oh, I know you won't.
Champion, the Horde is now at open war with the Alliance.
Our success in this conflict may depend on your skills.
I require your immediate presence in Orgrimmar for a mission of the utmost urgency. Do not keep me waiting.
You have no idea what you're up against, boy king. We've only just begun.
An army of militant orcs from another world, trained its soldiers, weapons waiting to be fixed upon the Alliance, interesting.
Farewell, Nathanus.
Champions, the hour is at hand. The Alliance shall fall upon our blades as they desperately grasp at our prized Lordaeron keep.
Is everything in order?
Good. Work with our champion to determine where we will secure a foothold first.
See it done and dispatch reports of your progress to me.
Report to High Overlord Saurfang. Teach them the price of their folly. For the Horde!
Champion, when Princess Talonji came to our seeking aid, I recognized an opportunity to add her kingdom's strength to our own.
I knew there was no one more capable of winning the Zandalari to our cause than you.
I am Sylvanas Windrunner, and I approve this message.
Champion, leaders of the Horde, I have summoned you here to discuss matters of war.
The Alliance's forces have held strong and show no signs of weakening.
Our soldiers grow weary. The Horde's ranks are in need of new blood. What are our options?
We sorely need the Zandalari and their fleet if we intend to engage the Alliance again.
She thinks to summon me. I suppose she has allowed some posturing today.
Congratulations, Your Majesty.
Yes, it is beyond time we did.
equals
I see. Very well. Queen Talandri. The Horde welcomes you.
You have performed admirably. Arrangements will be made to greet our new allies in Orgrimmar.
The Alliance believes that by striking down Rastakhan and decimating the Zandalari fleet, they have broken us. That the Horde will soon crumble.
Fools. The boy king has lied to himself and his people. He hasn't the faintest inkling of what he's truly up against.
War is a living thing. It arrives, it grows, twisting and turning until its final form is revealed.
This war is about to shift yet again, and it will be this blade that guides our way to victory.
I have troubling news.
Most of you need fear nothing.
But Derek Proudmoore didn't flee to Kul Tiras by himself.
Zelling
Thank you for your honesty.
No. He did. And so did you.
Take him!
There is no place for weakness in our ranks.
Remember your loyalties.
